status: Concept proposal only; no application changes or deployment
prompt:
Create one polished landscape 3:2 concept illustration for the INTERIOR SCHOOL LOBBY of a Korean elementary children's quiz game called QuizTown. This is a design proposal image, not a real website screenshot. Warm delicate gouache storybook illustration with fine soft outlines, cream plaster, honey oak wood, sage green accents, pastel colors and afternoon light. Match the mood of a charming woodland village with orange tiled school roof, arched windows, rabbits and squirrels; no modern sterile app dashboard.

Composition: a readable gently elevated frontal cutaway view into a spacious single-floor school lobby, like a welcoming playable picture-book location. Across the rear wall arrange FOUR distinct inviting classroom doorways evenly, each with generous blank wooden plaque above it for future HTML labels. Identify the four doors with simple iconic physical objects integrated above/next to them: open book and pencil, abacus and geometric shapes, globe and map, microscope and plant respectively. Keep doors large enough to click, not distant miniature details. On the left side wall a separate cozy entrance with children's drawings and backpack cubbies, representing our homeroom. On the right side a separate friendly games club entrance decorated with two colorful team pennants and a board-game symbol, representing online battles. These six destinations should be visually distinct with no overlap or blocked paths, no duplicate doorways.

Center foreground: a modest owl librarian/teacher wearing a green vest, beside a low friendly welcome desk and small freestanding chalkboard, leaving plenty of open wood floor so the scene breathes. A rabbit student and squirrel student with backpacks can stand near opposite sides, not block doors. Flower pots, wall clock, soft arched window light, a few shelves and books for atmosphere, restrained detail. No rows of desks filling the room, no maze, no staircase, no second floor. No text, no letters, no numbers, no speech bubbles, no UI controls, no watermark. Blank signboards deliberately reserved for real interface text later. Entire composition visible edge to edge; high quality cohesive hand-painted art, inviting and functional rather than busy.
